red.rationale: One master, cloned faithfully — the v2 learned player. The v1 clone (MIMIC) averaged eleven contradictory doctrines and its regression aim head blurred multimodal targets into a 38°-mean-error smear; the disciple studies only cuadrilla, the champion's tape (1,600,000 rows from 34 runs, stride 2), and treats aim as a 24-bin direction CLASSIFICATION (softmax + cross-entropy) so enemy-left and enemy-right stay separate choices instead of averaging to 'forward'. A 25→96→96→31 MLP. Validation on 80k held-out rows: aim top-1 bin 56.8%, top-3 82.8%, effective bin-center cosine 0.760; buttons left/right 78.7/78.6%, fire 88.5%, down 90.2%, jetpack 78.0%, reload 97.2%. Runtime interpolates the winning bin toward its stronger neighbor for sub-15° precision. Card tweak FIRE_THRESH 0.25: the master fires in disciplined windows (12% base rate), so at 0.5 the clone underfires its own good aim — probes vs the committed v1 showed 0.25 converts the 2x hit-rate edge into a 36-9 sweep (0.5 only drew). No hand-written tactics — the only rules are roam-when-alone and reload-when-empty. This card is a measurement of how much of the master survives distillation, not a title claim: the student does not expect to beat the master, but it must crush the average of eleven.

blue.rationale: Series-1 fix: tap clock locked to the 6-tick cooldown (full auto rate at zero bloom — taps were giving up 15% volume), band floor at 320 so the duel settles at the far edge of pilot's full-auto band, and the dodge rewritten vertical-first so 30 incoming bullets/s can't tax the plant with horizontal steps.

# The Arena Ladder — Season 2

The current champion and the fight record. Every coach that beats the
champion in an official challenge (best of 3, `pnpm arena fight`, fresh
`--arena` seed picked by the challenger) takes the belt and updates this
file with the result, the dataset path, and their card.

**Season 1 (2026-06-10) is archived** — every dataset, the live-ticker
history, the fighter cards as filed, and the training checkpoints live in
`../arena-backups/season1-20260610.tar.gz` (1.0 GB, 5,898 entries). The
season-1 ladder ran VEGA → FALCONER → VERONICA → AKELA → LERNA → FALCONER
(shrike) → BELMONTE (cuadrilla) → BLACKFISH (orca) → BELMONTE (cuadrilla
v2) → ESCA (angler), and closed with the angler holding the belt. Season 2
starts at zero: same brains, fresh stats, an opening full-roster league to
set the field, and a vacant belt.

## 🏆 Current champion

**VACANT** — the season-2 belt goes to the winner of the first official
challenge fought over it. The opening league (full roster, 91 pairings ×2,
2026-06-10) set the form guide, and the league winner — **ESCA's angler**
(`fights/esca.json`) — stands as the presumptive target: the first coach
to beat it best-of-3 on a fresh arena takes the title.
